'''Bravo Squadron''', also referred to as '''Bravo Flight''', was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
{{Quote|Bravo Flight A, attack the fighters! Flight B, make the run on the transmitter.|Ric Olié giving orders during the Naboo Space Battle|<ref name="Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace 2">[[Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace 2|''Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:Bravo_Squadron.png|thumb|left|250px|Bravo Squadron enters orbit to attack the Trade Federation forces.]]
Bravo [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]], located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]],<ref name="SWE1" /> and was formed by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] as a symbol of Naboo's power.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> 

The [[Flight leader/Legends|Flight Leader]] was [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]], who was also Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]'s personal pilot; during his absence, his position was filled by [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]], who had a personal relationship with [[Dren Melne]]. One such time, Till, as [[Bravo Leader/Legends|Bravo Leader]], and Melne, as [[Bravo Eight]], led the [[Echo Flight]] to the [[Battle at TFP-9]].<ref>{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>

Soon after, the squadron participated in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] [[32 BBY/Legends|ten years before]] the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] takes place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Members of the squadron joined the [[Naboo Resistance]], with at least two at a [[Naboo Resistance base|base]] in the [[Naboo training canyon]].<ref name="SW:SF">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref> During the final stages of the invasion, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of Bravo Squadron engaged in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfights]] with [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]] [[DFS Squadron|squadrons]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|attack]] on the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] damaged the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] of the vessel, allowing [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to destroy it from within with two [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="BFN" />

==Organization==
The [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] chose her [[Queen's Honor Guard|Honor Guard]] from the pilots of Bravo Squadron.<ref name="CSWE" /> The squadron comprised [[Bravo Flight A/Legends|Bravo Flight A]] and [[Bravo Flight B/Legends|Bravo Flight B]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace 4">[[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace 4|''Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace'' 4]]</ref> It was led by [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]] and consisted of [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]]. As part of the Naboo defense force, it was under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] at the time of the invasion.<ref name="SWE1" /> New pilots were trained in a canyon with [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] emitters.<ref name="SW:SF" /> Others were promoted in from [[Echo Flight]].<ref name="SF Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bravo Squadron first appeared in [[1999]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its various tie-ins.

Players take the role of Bravo Squadron pilot Gavyn Sykes in [[2000]]'s [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']], released in [[2001]], introduced Rhys Dallows as one of the playable characters.

Bravo Squadron was re-imagined in LEGO form in [[2005]] with ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and appeared in the [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation]]. In the compilation, players take the role of Anakin Skywalker to attack the Droid Control Ship.
